dateLabel: c. 2600-2000 BCE (city; Caral culture c. 3000-1800 BCE)
title: Caral: earliest known city in the Americas
summary: Caral, north of Lima, held pyramids, plazas and administrative buildings. It is considered the oldest city in the Americas and one of the oldest in the world.
why: Shows that cities and monumental building arose independently in the Americas around the time Egypt's great pyramids were built.
interchange: Early cities also in Mesopotamia and Egypt (no contact with the Americas)

notes.problem: Label used the culture span, not the city's 2600-2000 BCE; source says 'oldest city' claim is challenged; Mesopotamia comparison unsupported.
